comment: The downbeat and remainder outputs are forced to one channel whatever the clock carries (src/I.cpp:55-56). The phase knob is turned into a whole step number by multiplying the percentage by the ratio less a half and truncating (src/I.cpp:89), so a ratio of 1 always has phase 0 and the knob does nothing at that setting. The reset is a level rather than an edge: the count is held at zero for as long as it stays high (line 107). The master count wraps at 360 times 7 times 11 times 13, a number divisible by every ratio from 1 to 16, so the dividers stay in phase across the wrap (src/I.cpp:60 and 113). The panel prints D1, D2, D3, P1, P2, P3, CLK, RST, DWN, SANS, O1, O2, O3 and XOR.
